recordedProductIssues: Phone footage is a self-demo and the recorded guide is small

defects.problem: Link card fills the left, but the redaction bar wraps onto a second line under the URL, looking like a stray black block.
defects.fix: Make the mask one line, matching the URL width.

defects.problem: Phone panel is a narrow tall tile; instruction text inside it is unreadable at feed size, and the main tile shows the same tiny screenshot again.
defects.fix: Enlarge the phone tile and drop the redundant screenshot or reduce it.

defects.problem: Dissolve from the link card to the phone shows overlapping ghost text; phone top edge looks clipped.
defects.fix: Cut cleanly or shorten the dissolve; keep the phone edge fully inside the frame.

oneLineVerdict: Clear message of link to phone, but the phone proof is too small to read in a feed.
